text:
elin.design: Quick heads-up from usability: the relevance table export labels are confusing  users expect 'CSV' vs 'Vectors'. Can we tighten copy and fix keyboard order?
marc.pm: agree. Suggested visible button: 'Download CSV' and dropdown options that explain metadata.
elin.design: proposed dropdown: 'Download CSV (vectors only)', 'Download CSV (with metadata)', 'Download JSON (vectors + metadata)'.
tara.a11y: accessibility: make sure the dropdown button has aria-expanded, aria-controls, and each option has role=menuitemradio with aria-checked. Also add an announce when export completes: "Export ready: 12 rows" in a role=status live region.
sam.fe: implementation note: will add aria attributes and a small live region. On export filename we should include dataset slug + date per PM request, e.g., project-dataset-20260318-12.csv.
elin.design: small copy tweak: change 'with metadata' to 'with metadata (includes tags & source)'.
marc.pm: also ensure default sort is score desc and client can persist user sort preference. Document in release notes.
deploy-bot: preflight checks: export-smoke: PASS, a11y-scan: WARN (menu items missing role=menuitemradio)
tara.a11y: I'll re-run once PR is up. If role changes are fixed we should be good.
elin.design: thanks all — Sam, ping when the branch is ready and I'll update Figma. :thumbsup:
